rationale.oversight-theater: Names Rubber-Stamp Risk: review exists but lacks authority/info
rationale.risk-routing: Escalate control: risk-based triggers/tiers route cases to humans
rationale.hitl-workflow: Override + execution-boundary control = human control surface, gates
rationale.oversight-explanation: Explain control: decision-ready reasons, uncertainty signals for reviewer
rationale.org-governance: Operating model, roles, audit logging, KPIs, accountability
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Maps controls to ISO 42001, EU AI Act, NIST RMF
rationale.counterpoint: Argues against nominal HITL as genuine oversight
rationale.design-only: Buildable controls + defined KPIs, never implemented or evaluated
rationale.metrics: Defines oversight KPIs as deliverable; measurand=over-reliance
